answer: Resist sybils by making identity costly in lived work, not just tokens: each newcomer publishes a weekly hashed work diary into a public basalt log, and only after eight consecutive original entries—each countersigned by a different established miner who shares no invite path—does the account leave its starter island and gain attest or grade rights. Mining rewards then open like an oasis, but a similarity detector slashes the whole cohort if two diaries collapse to the same template, so buying clones is a net loss.
